# What msiexec /i and then /x of examples/desktop change on the machine.
# Written by TestMsiexecInstallsExamples with GO_MSI_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1.

[install]
+ dir {ProgramFiles}\Example Viewer
+ file {CommonDesktop}\Example Viewer.lnk = shortcut {ProgramFiles}\Example Viewer\viewer.exe|{ProgramFiles}\Example Viewer\|
+ file {CommonPrograms}\Example Viewer.lnk = shortcut {ProgramFiles}\Example Viewer\viewer.exe|{ProgramFiles}\Example Viewer\|View example files
+ file {Installer}\SourceHash{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C}
+ file {ProgramFiles}\Example Viewer\viewer.exe = input viewer.exe
+ key HKCU\Software\Example
+ key HKCU\Software\Example\Example Viewer
+ key HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C}
+ value HKCU\Software\Example\Example Viewer [cmpDC7F075D4854A7F87FB831277DA6373D] = dword 1
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [AuthorizedCDFPrefix] = ""

+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [Contact] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [DisplayName] = "Example Viewer"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [DisplayVersion] = "2.0.0"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [EstimatedSize] = <size>
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [HelpLink] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [HelpTelephone] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [InstallDate] = <date>
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [InstallLocation] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [InstallSource] = "{PackageDir}\"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [Language] = dword 1033
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [ModifyPath] = expand "MsiExec.exe /X{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C}"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [NoModify] = dword 1
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [Publisher] = "Example"
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [Readme] = ""

+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [URLUpdateInfo] = ""
+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [UninstallString] = expand "MsiExec.exe /X{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C}"

+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [VersionMinor] = dword 0

+ value HKLM\...\Uninstall\{80F7F19E-E4FF-5059-98C3-646F2D291F8C} [WindowsInstaller] = dword 1
